490302.caption: Hm? My hopes for the future? Don't think you'll get that out of me. And my past... Just consider it as a mystery.

490303.caption: If possible, I'd like to do some movie-related work after I get discharged. Expressing your thoughts with images is always easier than with words.

490304.caption: Is she here too? No wonder you got me confused with her. No, I'm happy she's here and that I remind you of her...

490305.caption: R-Really? You're really willing to watch that century-old sci-fi movie with me? ...Well, since your work is complete, I'll especially allow you to sit beside me... But you're not allowed to make any noise.
